title: Oozy Middle Eastern Pistachio Flatbread
description: A resinous and chewy Middle Eastern dish featuring unsalted pistachio and confit-tomato, perfect for a brunch mood. This raw-friendly flatbread is cooked on a tava-griddle.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, and salt.
Gradually add olive oil and water, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the tava-griddle over medium heat.
Roll out the dough into a large circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Spread the confit-tomato and chopped pistachio over the dough, leaving a 1 inch border.
Fold the border over the filling to form a crust.
Cook the flatbread for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Brush with pomegranate molasses and sprinkle with sumac.
